column1: # Maps every key_gloss.tsv row (code, source_run -- unique per NOTES.md check) to the crop and 1-based
# token position within that crop's printed line where its mark was read (ZX-BAR2, 25 Sept 2026).
# Position is ordinal within the ORIGINAL passA.tsv run (the run key_gloss.tsv's source_run column names,
# not ciphertext.tsv's reconciled/renumbered runs -- passA.tsv and ciphertext.tsv use different run_ids for
# the same physical spans past a point in the letter; see NOTES.md ZX-BAR2 section for why passA.tsv is the
# correct reference here). Derived from passA.tsv's own token order plus its per-run alignment notes (mostly
# explicit N-for-N exact/prefix gloss-to-token matches already documented in passA.tsv's own note column).
